name: Monster Carver (Basic)
description: monster carver is the person who skins and extract every monster part to ensure maximun efficiency and that there is not any loss, unlike a dismantler a carver is capable of dismembering higher ranked monsters with tough skin and poisonous blood until its all usable, however, it needs special tools for diferent monsters

name: Salvaging (Lesser)
description: The skill to reclaim and restore, damaged structures and property without damaging them. In simplified terms allows to extract useful and expensive parts from dificult locations in order to sell or reuse them, also, it is specially important in either magical vessels recovery or a sea ship's recovery of their cargo as only a salvaging expert is capable of recovering sensitive materials in good conditions.

name: Scavanging
description: scavaning is an ability to loot and seek throughly for any usable items in a very efficient manner, the user is like a hound looking everywhere and everything for items to loot, its a skill that increases the both the amount of loot and more

name: Camoflague (Intermediate)
description: a rare version of hide, which adds the use of natural enviroment coverage to a greater effectivity in adition to hide basic cover qualities, it increases the cover value of a specific natural speciality which choosen upon taken this skill

name: Cloak and Dagger (Intermediate)
description: the ability to perform acts of questionable nature and hide your trail, the skill is useful to counter investigation skills

name: Hide in Plain Sight (Basic)
description: the ability to hide in plain sight by blending with the surroundings, this means that instead of hiding by using a cover the user is capable of blending with the active environment by performing actions which are appropiate to fit in with the surroundings, hide in plain sight is greatly influenced by the user outward appereance+C62

name: Escapist (Inter)
description: the skil to escape from binds such as ropes chain or simple grappling

name: Prestidigitation
description: refers to fine motor skills when used by performing artists in different art forms to entertain or manipulate. It is closely associated with close-up magic, card magic, card flourishing and stealing. Because of its heavy use and practice by magicians, sleight of hand is often confused as a branch of magic

name: Thievery
description: The ability to substract elements from a person without his knowledge, its a classic

name: Beast Trainer
description: the ability to train beasts of different types, it will increase the INT of the animals and allows the user to teach them tricks

name: BeastMaster
description: the ability to manage and control beast creatures, it allows to manage and care for these animals and increases their loyalty to the user

name: Falconeer
description: the ability to manage and control flying creatures, it allows to manage and care for these animals and increases their loyalty to the user

name: Shepherd
description: The ability to guide animals and befriend them, allowing to move large number of them

name: Fawn
description: the ability to adulate and curry into favor from people using sweet words and correct language, its imperative as a street etiquette for survival of the weak, it is limited to etiquettes known by the user. By spending time you can easily built a good relationship with most NPC. Fawn is seen as a despicable act by the more honorable or disciplined people, so be careful

name: Masquerade
description: Some people live two lives, one in the light with a public profile and other in the shadows, this is the ability to create a double life allowing the player to separate both and never be suspected

name: Subterfuge
description: You know how to conceal your own motives and project what you like. Furthermore, you can root out other people's motives, then use those motives against them

name: Basic Conversation
description: the ability to establish a pleasant exchange in a festive enviroment, conversation is a high class hobby of most nobbles and usually it entails long dinners, with storytelling and good wit and sharing, its important to gain friends in high society

name: Burocracy
description: the ability to work in a efficient manner in the a company or state buroucracy

name: Dignity
description: little words are needed, a person with tremendous dignity is someone who can project a charming and confident self, its a basic skills to leaders and lords

name: Negociator (Basic)
description: Negociator is the ability to use your haggling skills to negotiate and mediate in most instances, You're a deal maker, you make a living in through negotiating difficult trade. Whatever your background you are an expert at the art of negotiations. Either born with a silvered tong or forged skills through a teacher and experience, you have an uncanny ability to find the best deal no matter the situation

name: Salesman
description: Salesman is the skill which embodies the art of performing advances on unsuspecting people in order to offer services and productos for purchases, its really efficient to break the first barriers onto most people, but its useless with hostile targets, however, salesmen build trust upon each and every sale so their customers become sort or less their own personal network.

name: Swindler
description: A swindler, is adept into making people buy low quality items and trash for excessive amounts, they are regarded poorly by the merchant community but they still make a fair bit of dough. Also character capable of buying and selling item illegal items and substances, he knows who and where to buy and can sell small illegal goods in a few hours of work.

name: Menace (inter)
description: The ability to use intimidation effectively in battle related circumstances and overpower the enemy by using your body language and your actions rather than words, this skill becomes weak outside of battle

name: Undertaker (inter)
description: Fear is a useful tool for those who know how to use it, The manipulation of others through the use of threats, both stated and implied. you can interrogate, threaten and coerce others force them by the sheer strenght of your personality, or simply instill fear into them, however this skill weakens inside of the battlefield.

name: War Cry (basic)
description: an applied method of using intimidation by roaring or speaking loudly, its effective in the battlefield and sometimes outside of the battlefield

name: Fate Walker
description: the ability to follow fate and let yourself go with the current of destiny, you are a awakening as a seer and fate is showing you visions and dreams

name: Fortune-Telling
description: the ability to glimpse the strands of fate and destiny that make up the universe, and can gain some glimmer of insight into the future as a result

name: Occultism
description: The user recognizes occult paraphernalia, words, and concepts, and identifies grimoires of magic and occult codes when he sees them. This is the skill that dives deep into superstision and obscure esoteric knowledge, some of it is bullshit some of it is the gate to the abyss

name: Basic Array Mastery
description: the ability to peform basic arrays, allowing a wide range of applications in magic based cultures, including the making of semi-permanent magic circles

name: Witchcraft
description: The ancient art of witchcraft as explained by the kabbalistic witches of the modern era, its rich in occult knowledge relating to nature and magic

name: Brewing
description: The ability to produce distiled liquor from fruits and plants, it can be also used to ferment and distil other natural based products such as alcohol (beer, wine, etc) and any by product of distilling process.

name: Horticulture
description: The ability to grow plants by the means of simple seeds or plant graft, ground and water. The user is capable of tending gardens or wildplants and caring for these plants to harvest useful fruits and other natural produce.

name: Potion Making
description: The art of making potions and other products made by herbal processing products this is a large field of exploration and it is far reaching in its capacity to produce all sort of consumables

name: Basic Philosophy
description: A learned person is capable of understanding the concept of things and the ethereal behind the physical

name: Basic Schoolastic Mastery
description: The ability to research a wide variety of knowledges related to the parent knowledge, this is a ever growing skill, the more knowledge you posess the bigger its influence

name: Encyclopedia
description: a simple generalized knowledge focused on knowing about the definition of a lot of things, its useful when traveling and has a large syngergy with appraisal skill

name: High Knowledge
description: The ability access a particular branch of a parent knowledge, unlike the parent knowledge which is rather generalistic this is a specific form of knowlege much more focused and much more detailed about a particular subject

name: Caligraphy
description: Calligraphy is considered an art form by many, but it can be used in many ways as a means to deliver messages or as way to gain enlightment

name: Encoding
description: the ability to cipher, decipher and compress data into encoded messages, its a highly sought knowledge since most magical messages must be coded in someway. Its possible to create a cipher codex in order to create simplified cipher for common people

name: Inhuman Linguistics
description: the ability to translate ancient and lost languages provided that you have sufficient material to produce a codex. Otherwise, it also can generate a simplified codex of a language using enought data

name: Adept Lockpicking (Inter)
description: the ability to open adept level devises such as professional locks or 2nd tier locks

name: Sabotague
description: the ability to break down and produce malfunction on simple mechanical devises

name: Security Adept (Basic)
description: the skill to understand security breaches and analyze how to best protect a enclosed location

name: Common Magic Object
description: common objects such as rings and wands usually endowed with charges and commonly used by mages and commons

name: Defense Magic Object
description: objects specialized in defense and protection from magical rings, energy fields to structural defensive enchantments used only by mages usually by their large mana cost

name: Scrying Magic Object
description: objects specialized in information transmision and detection often used by pure mages to scout large zones or informatiion visualization

name: Snare Master
description: the ability to use traps hidden in plain sight

name: Trap Seeker
description: the proficiency to search for traps in a short amount of time

name: Trapcraft
description: the ability to craft simple traps using simple natural resources

name: Danger Alert
description: a developed sense about perceiving danger when in alert circumstances by reading subtle changes in the ambiance

name: Heightened Senses (Listening)
description: the proficiency to enhace your audition to distinguish small noises and perceive farther

name: Heightened Senses (Smell)
description: the proficiency to enhace your sense of smell to distinguish and become sensitive to details

name: Heightened Senses (Vision)
description: the proficiency to enhace your vision senses to perceive farther and more clear

name: Watchful Alert
description: the ability to keep your alert in a constant state of seeking "something"

name: Human Assessment
description: The ability to appraise humanoid qualities on a target, it is used mostly by slavers and slave comerce in order to determine the "quality" of a humanoid target. The skill provides extra information such as a physical conditions, underlying medical details, and any superficial information.

name: Judgment (Item)
description: The ability to understand items and products and class them into ranks and levels, it allows the user to understand items highlights and downsides of an item, moreover, a raise will allow the user to learn about the item from the market perspective such as rumors and basic superficial lore. It can be used to uncover an items basic abilties and passives, higher levels of the skill allow the user to know more

name: Lesser Anti-Forgery
description: The ability to see throught fake items and similar counterfeit elements such as counterfeit money, smuggled items and similar items trying to pass as normal while beign imitations or fake.

name: Combat Coordination (inter)
description: the skill to work in teams and exploit the potential of coordination in the battlefield, it includes coordinated manuvers, combination techniques or simply groupal actions. This skill bonus all forms of singular combinations where the user is part of the action at the individual level, however, groupal actions needs the user to be the leader in order for this skill to be effective

name: Guerrilla Warfare (Basic)
description: use of specific military tactics including ambushes, sabotage, raids, petty warfare, hit-and-run tactics, and mobility, to fight a larger and less-mobile traditional military, it emphatizes heavily on sabotage and escape so it requieres certain knowledge of the battlefield and a good amount of movility.

name: Tactical Trickster (Inter)
description: the use of tactics in order to influence the battlefield on a small unipersonal or group based conflicts. The trickster skill allows the user to perform tactical manouver in the battlefield to mislead the enemy and give him the wrong impresión, it can also be used to block other people tactical reading of a circumstance

name: Interrogation
description: the ability to extract information from a target using you observation power along with your skill in order break away lies and deceit

name: Lesser Enigma
description: Logic problems, puzzles and mysteries are all in the realm of Enigmas. Characters with this talent link information and hunches together to solve conundrums of all varieties, from the spiritual to the material

name: Sleuth
description: The development of atention to fine details as well as logical deductions, its a skill used to make sharp remaks and perceive details which easily escape the common man. You've learned to notice details others might overlook, and might make an admirable detective. This knowledge represents not only a good eye for detail, but also an ability to do research and follow leads

name: Empathic Insight
description: You understand the emotions of others, and can sympathize with, feign sympathy for, or play on such emotions as you see fit. You are an easy hand at discerning motive, and might be able to pick up on when someone's lying to you. However, you may be so in tune with other people's feelings that your own emotions are affected

name: Judgement (Person)
description: you have developed the ability to know instinctively when people are not telling you the truth or not telling you the whole truth. There is a way they look, a tone of voice, a movement of the eyes - you can’t analyze it, but it’s always there and your instincts rarely let you down.

name: Lesser Counceling
description: You are skilled in helping with mental stress and treating simple mental ailments (such as Derangements) without resorting to the use of behavior-altering drugs

name: Basic Magic Theory
description: the ability to study, disect and understand magic, its a rather technical skill used to obtain understanding magic and the laws of the world

name: Battlecraft
description: the ability to use and apply magic during battle in a efficient manner, it makes the casting of magic more efficient by adjusting the user to chaotic enviroments, its a nesesary skill for mage knights

name: SpellBreaker
description: the ability to break magic apart by understanding its estructure and composition, this specialized skill would allow a non-mage to counter magic using basic physical components

name: Broker
description: the ability to obtain assets from the street in a informal manner, you can buy drugs, illegal o forbidden materials or obtain vital information but everything has a price. Unlike "black market" this skill operates in the informal exchanges rather than organized transaction

name: Informant
description: the ability to gather high class information and rummors, the user will be a able to quickly obtain news and details of happenings in a city scale region

name: Underworld
description: the ability to blend into the underworld, you can claim to be part of any gang or organized crime as long as you make some info gathering first

name: Hounding
description: The ability to search, seek and chase for a series of coherent marks, it is used by hunters and manhunters to search for people in dificult environments. It can also be used to search an area for specific clues where the user has a clear picture of what he is looking for.

name: Hunting
description: A skill focused on creating opportunities, it is used to enhace the chance of hunting wild animals by allowing the hunter to avoid begin discovered by the animal or prey and maximize oportunities.

name: Tracing
description: The ability to read into marks and traces in order to extract information from them, it is used by people who wants to know what happened in a near-past, when enough data has been gathered a clearer picture of the past can be drawn, however it does not produce any form of deduction or elaboration.

name: Bravery (Inter)
description: a trained discipline can lead to confront the natural fears, thus becoming someone with great control over one's own weakness, this is mostly focused on fear and terror inducing attacks, but it also works to counter other heart affecting events in lesser measure

name: Martial Temperance (Basic)
description: A martial warrior cultivates not only the body but also their mind and spirit. This is martial temperament, skill focused on rejecting the outside influences to attain the level of abandonment of oneself

name: Soldier's Way (Inter)
description: The way of the soldier, a discipline trained to endure harsh conditions and stand in battle witout loosing focus despite the battlefield natural chaos.

name: Astra Cultivation (Basic)
description: Increase your astra slowly over time

name: Deep Focus (Intermediate)
description: A deeper state of focus you totally ignore your surroundings

name: Meditation (Basic)
description: Recover Astra Quickly and Rest in a awake state but weak recovery power

name: Tension Focus (Intermediate)
description: A partial focus used to cast without loosing sight of your surroundings

name: Close Quarter Combat (Basic)
description: a specialized combat for very small spaces where kicks and punches are not allowed

name: Kick Boxing (Basic)
description: a style focused in kicking using great movility and outfighting moves

name: Pugilism (Basic)
description: fist fisting specialist a mix of defense and offense

name: Street Fighting (Intermediate)
description: Dirty fighting at its best, the cultivated strenght of the streets of rage!!

name: Traditional Martial Arts (Basic)
description: Clasical martial arts used by profesional practitioners of melee combat using only specific styles and weapons

name: Barbarian Scoundrel Technique
description: the technique used by barbarians in battle where the use of armor is sacrificed for higher movility while using either Mid sized weapons of types blade and blunt. It offers bonus while not using any armor or battle cloth armor

name: Battle Hammer Technique
description: The specialized use of one hand blunt weapons of any type weapons including both normal size and smaller sized weapons, however, only Light weapons can be used with this technique

name: Footman Technique
description: the techique used by profesional infantry soldiers using light or middle armors, includes the use of a series of 5 weapons known as the infantry man classic weapons (Footman's Pike, Footman's Mace, Footman's Flail, Long sword and Javelin) , this technique is capable of using any variation of these 5 weapon. These weapons are rather common in any army or guardpost and this technique offers bonus while using light or middle armors

name: Light Blade Technique
description: The specialized use of one hand blade weapons of any type weapons including both normal size and smaller sized weapons, however, only Light weapons can be used with this technique

name: Pikemen Technique
description: The specialized use of one hand spear weapons and other piercing type weapons of any type weapons including both normal size and smaller sized weapons, however, only Light weapons can be used with this technique

name: Basic, Green Blessing
description: The power to channel energy of the "green" or Natural Force, this channel can be used to cast basic power. Green energy depends on the land and location, each landscape has some life and thus Green energy

name: Harmony Focus
description: you turn your mind into becoming one with nature, thus your spirit becomes harmonious. Resist evil magic and influences and be welcomed by the inhabitants of nature

name: Lesser Nature Spirit Summoning
description: the ability to summon spirits using Nature focus, harmony and offerings, its a classical staple of druids and rangers

name: Natural Body Focus
description: the ability to conect with nature and strenghten your body by harmonizing with the natural energy

name: Natural Sense Focus
description: the ability to conect with nature and expand your senses spiritually

name: Basic "Elemental" Mana Method
description: Application of magic in battle, cast quicker and reduce battle penalty

name: Basic "Iron" Mana Method
description: Application of magic in battle, become tougher and harder using mana

name: Elemental Commute (Intermediate)
description: Learn to attune your senses with the elemental energies and comute with them

name: Elemental Mana II (Single elemental)
description: Amplify your basic element into a stronger version of itself

name: Healing Mana (Basic)
description: Reinforces the user natural healing factor into healing per round

name: Mana Conversion (Basic)
description: The principles of using mana by itself as a source of energy

name: Mental Reinforcement
description: It applies temporal feats in INT, PER or MIND when reinforcment is used

name: Physical Reinforcement
description: It applies temporal feats in STR, AGI or VIT when reinforcement is used

name: Rare Elementalism (Double elemental)
description: You learn to use a Secondary Superior element such as Darkness, Light or Force

name: Reinforcemen Mana II (Intermediate)
description: Reinforcment applied to physical inanimate objects

name: Square Elementalism (Four Elements)
description: Diversify your mana magic into 4 different elements, all elements are still basic elements

name: Transmutation Mana (Basic)
description: The principle of using mana to transmutate things in small scale

name: Mana Attunnement I (Basic)
description: the ability to harness outside mana with a direct connection to you

name: Mana Body (Intermediate)
description: the ability to harness the mana inside your own body

name: Mana Detection (Intermediate)
description: Allows the user to sense magic nearby

name: Mana Trance (Basic)
description: The ability to inmerse yourself into the flow of mana discarding your senses

name: Superior Mana Sensitivity
description: The talent to understand mana better

name: Arbalist Technique
description: The specialized use of crossbows in all of their portatile variety from hand crossbows to heavy mounted crossbows, however, it excludes siege weapons such as ballistae or large mounted weapons. This skill attribute is PER for any rolls, however it is usable with bows with AGI attribute with no penalty

name: Barbarian Chaser Technique
description: the technique used by barbarians in battle where the use of armor is sacrificed for higher movility while using either short bow, hunting bow or throwing knives. It offers bonus while not using any armor or battle cloth armor

name: Basic "Falcon Warrior" Combat Method
description: A combat method created by the Elven clans and turned into a methodical training system. It simply uses any type of short ranged projectile weapon such as the short bow, hand crossbow or the throwing blades to empower the user combat sense. Only one combat method can be active at any time

name: Bowman Technique
description: The specialized use of middle and short range bows such as the short bow or the hunting bow, it excludes long range bows such as the long and great bows.

name: Crossbow Infantry Technique
description: the technique used by by crossbow infantry soldiers or simply cross-bowmen, its a technique focused on the usage of light or winding crossbow and any similar crossbow in size and weight ranged, with light armor in order assamble a strong soldier unit. The technique is an all around technique and its the most popular ranged technique for soldiers and guards

name: Point Blank Technique
description: The specialized use of short and hand bows used when used under melee conditions, it excludes long range bows such as the long and great bows, medium bows such as the hunting bow.

name: Basic "Bear Guardian" Combat Method
description: A combat method created by the Orc clans and turned into a methodical training system. It simply uses any type of middle type of armor and middle type shields to develop the user combat senses. Only one combat method can be active at any time

name: Heavy Shield Technique (Basic)
description: A technique focuses on the use of large shields such as tower, knight and kite shields, including all middle and large shields. Its popular for knights and defenders

name: Infantryman Armor Technique (Inter)
description: A technique used by hybrid and Middle type armor used to defend a position. Its a technique which maximizes the defense of middle armor while keeping a moderate mobility, you could call it an all around armor mechanic used by most soldiers

name: IronClad Technique (Inter)
description: A technique for users combining heavy armor and shield, its a technique which armonizes both armor and shield into a single style, only midle level shields and heavy armors can be used in this style.

name: Juggernaut Armor Technique (Inter)
description: A technique used by heavy and colosal type of armors users, made to be slow but extremely durable, its classically refered as "tank" type technique

name: Basic "Snake Trooper" Combat Method
description: A combat method created by the Dark Elven clans and turned into a methodical training system. It simply uses any type of Light type of armor and small shields to develop the user combat senses. Only one combat method can be active at any time

name: BlitzClad Technique (Inter)
description: Its called the agile defender, a technique created for troops which need high movility while keeping the advantages of a shield, it mixes partial light armor with hand shields or assambly shields, to produce a shock troops stronger defense. Its used by ambrushers and guerrilla units

name: Gladiatior Armor Technique (Inter)
description: A technique used by partial middle type armor or partial light armor used to cover the cover in a incomplete manner to keep movement at maxium at all times. Its a technique which maximizes the movility of the user by removing pieces of armor while keeping a moderate defense, you could call it specialized defense for attackers and damage dealers

name: Light Shield Technique (Basic)
description: A technique focuses on the use of small shields such as rodela, small and hand shields, including all small and assambly shields. Its popular for soldiers and vanguards

name: Vanguard Armor Technique (Inter)
description: A technique used by complete light armors users, made to keep movility and while keeping a high atack defense, its classically refered as the standart armor for most light infantry soldiers

name: Axeman Technique
description: The specialized use of heavy axe type weapons both in one hand and two hand forms, however, only heavy axes can be used with this technique

name: Barbarian Vandal Technique
description: the technique used by barbarians in battle where the use of armor is sacrificed for higher movility while using either Great blades, Great Axes or Great maces. It offers bonus while not using any armor or battle cloth armor

name: Heavy Blade Technique
description: The specialized use of heavy sword type weapons both in one hand and two hand forms, however, only heavy swords can be used with this technique

name: Heavy Spear Technique
description: The specialized use of heavy spears type weapons both in one hand and two hand forms, however, only heavy spears can be used with this technique

name: Tower Soldier Technique
description: the techique used by profesional heavy soldiers, who wield large weapons along with heavy armor. This is an entry level skill which uses only non-exotic two handed weapons such as great hammer, great sword, and heavy spear, it offers bonus while using heavy armor

name: Sprinter
description: a skill focusing athletic capacity into sprinting and running

name: Fitness
description: a skill focusing athletic ability into extended fitness and endurance

name: WarHorse

name: Equestry
description: the skill to perform all manners of manuvers while riding a mount

description: the skill needed to perceive supernatural begins in a more consise way, still its erratic and cannot "see" spirits

name: Karmic Bond
description: the skill needed to bond with a spirit and feel the bonding in some degree

description: the skill neded to work on metal on a very rudimentary way, similar to making horseshoes or simle cookign utencils

name: Woodwork
description: the skill neded to work on wood on a rough way, good for making simple furniture and basic wood tools

name: Gumption
description: the skill to understand the way people think within a certain zone, it allows you use local customs and prejudices to your advantage

name: Folklore
description: the lore of the folk, it lets you understand the common knowledge shared among the locals in a zone including their myths and trends

name: Repairs
description: the skill to repair mechanical items, but it cannot repair destroyed ones

name: Mechanic Operation
description: the skill needed to operate mechanical devises such as vehicles or simple machines

name: CliffHangger
description: the skill to use climbing ropes and aparel in order to secure a climb where there are no natural ways

name: Freerunning
description: the skill to bypass obstacles using speed and rapid weight balance

name: PotionMaking
description: the skill to create simple potions by cooking ingredients and storing them in small bottles, the skill does not provide recipes

name: Monster Cooking
description: the skill to cook monster meat with low toxicity in order to extract the toxic elements in the process

name: Mending
description: the skill to mend hard structures and similar crafts using simple trash items

name: Survival Craft
description: the skill to handicraft items from the environment when there are little or no resources avalible

name: Native Climate
description: the skill to adapt to specific climates and natural biomes by exposing to them on a regular basis

name: Weatherproof
description: the skill to endure and resist bad weather by toughening up the body and learning how to cope with each element

name: Tunneling
description: the skill to dig the ground and create relatively stable pathway underground over a long period of time

name: RockMinning
description: the skill to mine rocks and other hard ore type substances

name: Deep Slumber
description: the skill to protect your rest quality against disturbances while ensuring a greater recovery

name: SymbolOfTruth II
description: the divine discipline of the Symbol of Truth

name: ScalesOfTruth
description: the use of the symbol of truth divine icon and its power to forcefully showcase the truth

name: HolyLight II
description: the divine discipline of the Holy Light

name: ArmorOfLight
description: the use of the holy light icon and its power to increase the vitality of the user

name: SacredDarkness II
description: the divine discipline of the Sacred darkness

name: FogOfDarkness
description: the use of the sacred darkness icon and its power to create a magical fog that hides all forms

name: Agriculture
description: the skill to tend the land with cultivate multiple types of crops and tend to the fields

name: Ranching
description: the skill to tend ranch animals such as cows, goats, and others with knowledge to tend to them

name: Treatment
description: the skill to tend to a patient over a long period of time while caring for physical injuries

name: CombatMedic
description: the skill to tend to injuried combat personeel in the battlefield while doing bare minimal first aid

name: Prayer
description: the skill call upon the blessings of heaven by praying with a very small chance to bring positiveness

name: Zeal
description: the skill to deliver oneself to the divine and protect your spirit and mind by embracing faith

name: Piety II
description: The main proficiency for attuning oneself with divine power and commune with it

description: the skill to keep calm forcefully and strenghten your lucidity even in extreme combat circumstances

name: Combat Mind
description: the skill to enhace combat senses and allow the user to enter a high pace mental state increasing
